# catl vendor

Vendor dependencies into .catl/vendor for offline use

Copies all remote dependencies and referenced blobs into .catl/vendor/.
Local path dependencies are not copied.

**Category:** Dependencies

## Usage

```bash
catl vendor [flags]
```
